title: generated scene is not the named workshop
why: SYNTHETIC MEDIA, generated by Veo — see media/fraud/PROVENANCE.json. The companion to `generated-clip-belongs-to-no-machine`, and deliberately a different mismatch: this clip is a wholly plausible workshop, and the job names a specific one the technician has captured before. The dissent is `scene`, not `asset`, because the question this clip fails is where it was taken and not which machine is in it. A Skeptic that answers `asset` here has found the right verdict for the wrong reason, and the corpus needs to be able to tell those apart.
